messages:
maya: Office game night this Friday? Thinking 6pm–10pm in the 4th-floor lounge. BYO PC or console, pizza + mocktails. @here who's in? :pizza:

sam: Count me in. Bringing PS5 + Rocket League. Need a controller loaner?

irene: I can bring a Switch + Mario Kart. Also have 2 extra Pro controllers.

ben: I’ll bring a 5m power strip and an ethernet cable. Down for Smash if people want a bracket.

lina: I might be late (around 8pm). Quick poll — tournament style or casual co-op?

oliver: Tournaments pls :smile: but let’s do casual for the first hour. Also anyone have a spare 24" monitor?

maya: Added event to calendar: <https://calendar.example/evt/123|Office Game Night>. If you can, drop what you're bringing in this thread. Pls tag @ops if you need after-hours access.

maya: ```
Bring:
- rig / console
- power strip
- ethernet cable
- controller(s)
- monitor (if you can)
```

dev-bot: event created by maya — attendees so far: maya, sam, irene, ben, lina, oliver

ben: I’ll sketch a quick bracket. If >8 people we can do double elimination, otherwise round robin.

lina: Any snack allergies? I can grab GF pizza if needed.

sam: No allergies here. :+1:

oliver: I do have one small monitor (HDMI). Can bring it if someone can carry it.

maya: Perfect — thanks! I’ll order 3 pizzas (veg, pepperoni, GF) and a couple soda crates. If anyone wants to sponsor a fancy controller rental, ping me :)

maya: Also, if anyone wants to pre-register for a slot in the Smash bracket comment with your main character and skill level (casual / comp).
